title: Motion-Activated Hallway Lighting
desc: Motion sensor detects movement -> Turn on pathway lights with auto-off after 5 min vacancy.

title: Midnight Amber Nightlight
desc: Motion detected between 11 PM and 6 AM -> Dim bathroom/hallway lights to 10% amber to protect night vision.

title: Vacant Room Auto-Off
desc: No motion detected for 10 minutes -> Automatically switch off lights to save energy.

title: Welcome Home Exterior Lighting
desc: First person arrives home after sunset -> Turn on porch and entryway fixtures.

title: All-Off on Departure
desc: Last person leaves the home zone -> Turn off all lights and non-essential switches.

title: Open Door HVAC Cutoff
desc: Exterior door or window stays open > 3 minutes -> Pause thermostat heating/cooling.

title: Resume HVAC on Door Close
desc: All exterior doors closed after cutoff -> Restore climate schedule.

title: Movie Mode Lighting Sync
desc: TV media player changes to playing -> Dim ambient lamps down to 15%.

title: Snack Pause Illumination
desc: Media player paused during movie -> Raise ambient lights to 40%.

title: Left Open Door / Window Alert
desc: Exterior door open continuously > 15 minutes -> Send push alert to phones.

title: Sunrise Blinds Opening
desc: Sun rises above horizon -> Open motorized shades/curtains.

title: Sunset Shade Closure
desc: Sun sets below horizon -> Lower motorized blinds for privacy.

title: Laundry Finished Alert
desc: Washer/Dryer smart plug power draw drops below 3W -> Send completion alert.

title: Nightly Perimeter Lockup
desc: Time reaches 10:30 PM -> Check status and automatically lock all smart locks.

title: Pantry / Closet Auto-Lighting
desc: Door contact sensor opens -> Turn on closet light immediately; off on close.

title: Nightly Security Audit
desc: Time reaches 11:00 PM -> Send notification if any exterior door or window remains open.

title: Desk Accent Follows PC
desc: Computer monitor or PC plug draws > 30W -> Turn on desk LED light strips.

title: Bathroom Humidity Exhaust
desc: Bathroom humidity exceeds 70% -> Switch on exhaust fan plug/relay.

title: Media Idle Auto-Power
desc: TV media player idle > 30 minutes -> Switch off AV receiver & media bar power.

title: Driveway Motion Speaker Chime
desc: Driveway or porch motion trips -> Soft audio chime on indoor speaker.
